scenarios.title: A creature with flying can be blocked only by creatures with flying or reach
decisions: A attacks player B with its Wind Drake.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of A's Wind Drake.

variants.label: ground_blocker
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears (no flying or reach) as a blocker of A's Wind Drake is illegal.

variants.label: reach_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Giant Spider (reach) as the blocker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Declaring Giant Spider as a blocker of A's Wind Drake is legal.

variants.label: flying_blocker
variants.delta: B declares its own Wind Drake (flying) as the blocker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Declaring B's Wind Drake as a blocker of A's Wind Drake is legal.
